request: Our campus has a lost-and-found desk and we want a simple board for it. Anyone who finds something can report it with a short description of the item, where they found it and the date they found it. People should be able to see all the items on the board and look at one item. When the owner comes to collect an item, the desk marks it as claimed and writes down the owner's name. An item that has already been claimed cannot be claimed again. We also want to see only the items that are still waiting for their owners.
summary:
I've built the lost-and-found board, and all 8 of my automated checks pass. Items are saved in a file called `lostandfound.db` in the project folder.

**What the board can do:**
- **Report a found item:** `POST /items` with a description, the place it was found and the date (written like 2024-05-01). Every new item starts as unclaimed. The board refuses a report if anything is missing or blank, or if the date isn't a real date.
- **See all items:** `GET /items` lists every item, claimed or not.
- **See only items still waiting for their owners:** `GET /items/unclaimed`.
- **Look at one item:** `GET /items/{id}` shows that one item. If no item has that number, you get a "not found" message.
- **Mark an item as claimed:** `POST /items/{id}/claim` with the owner's name. This marks the item as claimed and saves the name. If the item was already claimed, the board refuses and keeps the original owner's name. It also refuses a blank name or an item number that doesn't exist.

I also added one safeguard you didn't ask for directly: if two staff members try to claim the same item at the same moment, only the first one goes through.
